p1_a_paired_provider_authority_forwardin.observed_condition: When PairedAcquisitionCoordinator.admit_paired(provider_batch=...) received valid authorization and admission, its _context_unit constructed ProviderAcquisition(ctx_cap, core=..., operational=...) without forwarding authorization or admission. This caused _open_context to fail with AdmissionRefused('PERMISSION_DENIED'), leaving Core committed and Context rejected.
p1_a_paired_provider_authority_forwardin.root_cause: src/repo_catalog/application/acquisition.py:2003 constructed ProviderAcquisition without authorization=self.authorization, admission=self.admission, and Context.for_transaction did not receive authorization/admission binding parameters.
p1_a_paired_provider_authority_forwardin.remediation: Forwarded self.authorization and self.admission into Context.for_transaction and into ProviderAcquisition in both admit_paired and reconcile_core_dependencies. The same trusted, validated service-issued authority now reaches every nested Context operation.

p1_b_exchange_finite_grants_and_fallback.observed_condition: When a receiver supplied permitted_repository_uuidv4s but omitted authorization/admission, the fallback constructed LocalAuthorizationPolicy with grants=None, which unconditionally denied resource dependencies. Furthermore, if Core committed before Context evaluated resource admission, Core could commit while Context failed.
p1_b_exchange_finite_grants_and_fallback.root_cause: src/repo_catalog/application/exchange.py:1798 and 1885 invoked create_local_admission_service without grants; _import_package lacked grants propagation and pre-transaction receiver authority validation.
p1_b_exchange_finite_grants_and_fallback.remediation: Added explicit grants parameter to ExchangeService.__init__ and import_package. Added _validate_receiver_authority preflight check before coordinator.admit and before Context.transaction. Permitted repository without finite resource grant fails closed immediately with typed PERMISSION_DENIED and zero database writes. When receiver supplies finite grants, Resource imports succeed in both Core+Context and Context-only receivers.

p2_selection_admission_behavioral_execut.observed_condition: test_receiver_empty_selection_admits_zero_resources and test_receiver_selective_subset_omits_unselected_sender_resources only constructed ExchangePackage and ExchangeSelectionScope without calling import_package, inspecting database state, or observing policy leases.
p2_selection_admission_behavioral_execut.root_cause: Non-behavioral assertions that did not execute real admission paths.
p2_selection_admission_behavioral_execut.remediation: Replaced both tests with full end-to-end integration tests using genuine SQLite sender and receiver stores, export_package, import_package, SQLite database row inspections, and policy call observations confirming exact subset admission and zero unselected admission.
